title: Find the Width of Columns of a Grid
summary: Given a 0-indexed m x n integer matrix grid, return an array ans of size n where ans[i] is the width of column i. A column's width is the maximum length of its integers; a negative integer's length includes its minus sign.
officialConstraints: -10^9 <= grid[r][c] <= 10^9 (the source page shows the exponent as 109; the search summary confirms -10^9 to 10^9)
visualizationNotes: Visualization uses the full official limits (m, n up to 100); the trace has about 2 frames per cell.
